verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an auth framework, and auth platforms can plausibly offer automations (hooks or actions) with versioning, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no automation feature with its own versioning, review, or rollback. The homepage claim that auth config 'lives in code version controlled... reviewable in PRs' [45] describes git and PR workflows the user supplies, applied to auth configuration rather than automations, so it is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
